notes: full run: each wired pair's native estimator was run and the candidate judged against it (tolerance = max(sigma_k * std, floor); pass within 1x, fail beyond 2x)
1 bag topic(s) without a sensor role are not listed

assumptions: first order: each pair reads R_parent_child w (rotation) and R_parent_child u (translation) for a child frame turned by w and moved by u, -w and t_parent_child x w - u for a parent frame
the pairs' errors are independent; pairs that share an input make the tests optimistic
a bias shared by every pair through one frame (one estimator type) reads as that frame turned or moved
an axis std is used at least at the verdicts' rotation or translation floor over sigma_k
a direction of a frame's turn and shift that the pairs constrain worse than the floors (std above them) is not fitted; an own axis mostly along such directions is undetermined
